The '''RLG guardian droid system''' was manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It consisted of two identical bodyguard [[Droid/Legends|droid]] units. One 15-centimeter tall droid could be kept in a [[recharging unit]] in a small pouch worn on the owner's waist while the other droid served as a bodyguard for up to twelve hours before its own [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] required recharging, at which time the units would be switched, so that the owner was never without the protection of a charged unit. If necessary, both units, could be used at the same time. Each unit was equipped with an alarm, an internal [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]], a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] drive unit, a [[FullSpec]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package (visual, [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]], [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]], and full motion), and programming to detect ambushes, hidden weapons, suspect behavior, and (when appropriately programmed) specific threats. The system cost 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new (1,000 credits used), with an optional remote unit (500-meter range) available for 300 credits, allowing the owner to not only control the droid but receive video and audio data broadcast to the remote by the droids. Though not originally marketed to illegitimate customers, the model proved a popular bodyguard with [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]].
